Hi,

Regarding my delayed Hammer Thor P2 order, I understand that you are
offering the option to swap it for another order.

I would be more than happy to upgrade my Thor P2 to a Thor P3 and pay the
price difference.

Would this be possible? If so, please let me know how much the difference
would be and how I can proceed with the upgrade.

Thank you!
Barbu M.
+(number hidden)
(address hidden)
Note to the team: I'll look into this. Let me check the catalog and find his order.
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner Thor P3

Hi Marius,

Thanks for writing, and yes, a swap is possible on your order Shop····, which has not shipped yet.

One thing first: there is no Thor P3 in our lineup, so there is nothing to upgrade to under that name. The two units people move up to from the Thor P2 are the Magic Miner 40T (40 TH/s, $799) and the Harlo B30 (30 TH/s, $899). Against the $369 on your P2 line, the difference would be $430 for the Magic Miner 40T or $530 for the Harlo B30. Both are pre-orders that ship by November 30, 2026, so a little later than your Thor P2, which ships no later than October 29.

Nothing is charged until you decide. Just reply with the one you want and I will make the swap on this same order myself, keeping your order number. The store then emails you an invoice for the difference, and the unit ships once that is paid.

If you would rather stay with the Thor P2 after all, that is fine too, and the $25 next-order coupon we mentioned in our October 5 notice is still yours, just say the word and I will issue it. You can also follow the incoming batch at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Let me know which way you want to go and I will take care of it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
